cases.sentence: В начале правления ___ Цедекии, сына Иосии , к Иеремии было такое слово от Господа: 2 Так мне сказал Господь:
cases.explain: «иудейского царя» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

cases.sentence: Ныне Я отдам все ваши земли Моему слуге Навуходоносору, царю Вавилона; Я покорю ему даже ___.
cases.explain: «диких зверей» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant. I have also given the animals of the field to him to serve him.

cases.explain: «многочисленные народы» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: All the nations will serve him, his son, and his son’s son, until the time of his own land comes. Then many nations and great kings will make him their bondservant.

cases.explain: «великие цари» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: All the nations will serve him, his son, and his son’s son, until the time of his own land comes. Then many nations and great kings will make him their bondservant.
